brief.subject: EUDR Brief: EU forest cover steady, Commissioner at EUDR event
brief.headline: EU forest cover holds near 39% as Commissioner attends EUDR event
brief.dek: New EU land data, a Commissioner appearance at an EUDR event, and a cocoa replacer aimed at supply risk.
brief.lede: Today's sources carry no new EUDR deadlines or guidance. New Commission figures put EU forest cover at approximately 39% of total land.

sections.heading: EU forests steady, habitats struggling
bullets: EU forest cover has stabilised at approximately 39% of total land, per the Commission's environment newsroom.
26.4% of total EU land is designated as protected, framing the EU's domestic conservation baseline.
81% of protected EU habitats have a poor or bad conservation status, a gap critics of EUDR enforcement may highlight.

sections.heading: Commissioner appears at EUDR event
bullets: The Commission's environment newsroom reports a Commissioner attended an EUDR event.
No details on announcements, guidance or timelines were published, so compliance plans need no change yet.

sections.heading: Cocoa replacer targets supply risk
bullets: Planet A Foods launched Cocoa Booster, a high-fiber cocoa powder replacer.
It can replace up to 100% of cocoa in select applications, a signal for cocoa exporters watching demand.
The launch cites rising cocoa costs and GLP-1-driven shifts in consumer demand.
